The multicomponent alloy Fe 44.5 Co 25.4 Ni 24.4 Ti 5.7 ingot was cast by vacuum levitation melting.
Homogenization treatment was performed at 1150 °C for 24 h in an argon atmosphere controlled horizontal tube furnace followed by water quenching.
The homogenized ingot was then subjected to cold rolling with a cold reduction of 85%.
